input.quote: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.
input.rationale: The only ownership provision (§ 2(d)) is one-directional: it confirms TrueLink's retained ownership and licence rights in the Interface but says nothing about Client. Nothing gives Client ownership of, or any licence to, the deliverables/work product of the Support Services Client pays for (§ 10(b) treats those results only as confidential), and there is no affirmative statement that Client retains rights in its own Intellectual Property or its borrower/loan data, so the clause fails even the fallback. We therefore insert one short Client-side subsection carrying the preferred position: assignment and Client ownership of Support Services deliverables and work product, a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any embedded TrueLink IP, Client retention of its IP and data, and no joint ownership. TrueLink's retention of its pre-existing Interface rights is preserved verbatim, and the § 8(d) non-exclusive Credit Data licence is expressly carved out (it is a licence rather than an assignment and part of the bargain with the Non-Competition Agreement, so we do not redline it).

ops.text: e. Client Ownership. TrueLink hereby assigns to Client all right, title and interest in the deliverables and work product of the Support Services created for Client, which Client shall own, and grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any TrueLink Intellectual Property embedded in such deliverables and work product. Subject to the license granted in Section 8(d), Client retains all right, title and interest in Client's Intellectual Property and all data provided by or on behalf of Client or generated through Client's use of the Interface. No joint ownership of any intellectual property is created by this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 2(d) confirms only TrueLink's rights in the Interface, so we add a short Client-side subsection: we own the deliverables and work product of the Support Services we pay for (with a licence back to any embedded TrueLink IP), we retain our own IP and our borrower/loan data, and no joint ownership is created. TrueLink's ownership of the Interface and the Section 8(d) Credit Data licence are untouched.
proposal.summary: Insert Client-side ownership subsection: assignment of Support Services deliverables and work product, licence-back of embedded TrueLink IP, Client retention of its IP and data, no joint ownership
